init-6.name: Init-6
init-6.about: The fund of Bukalapak's two co-founders, investing pre-seed and seed in Indonesian startups since 2020 — with occasional consumer-brand and overseas bets. Arif Medianto is Managing Partner and Rexi Christopher Venture Partner. Its census portfolio was verified company by company on 30 Aug 2026 from the fund's own portfolio page, its news archive and its LinkedIn.

outside.name: Schoters
outside.why: Init-6's own portfolio marks it Exited. Schoters still runs its own PT Partner Impian Milenial, but it is a wholly-owned Ruangguru subsidiary and a row would double-count Ruangguru's workforce — the same rule that keeps TikTok Shop Indonesia inside the PT Tokopedia row.

outside.name: Showwcase
outside.why: A United States developer-network startup (Init-6's Jan-2022 announcement says so itself). Not an Indonesian company, whatever its expansion plans were.

outside.name: DIN (Dbank)
outside.why: Din Global Pte Ltd — a Singapore holdco operating in Pakistan (the Dbank digital-bank licence bid, then DCore, then Waseela). US$17.6M seed co-led by Sequoia SEA and Kleiner Perkins. Categorically out of region, and din.global no longer resolves.

outside.name: Aigis
outside.why: YC W22 corporate-wellness startup (PT Maju Finansial Digital; US$1M from Y Combinator and Init-6, May 2022). By Aug 2026 its site answers HTTP 525, its LinkedIn company page is gone, and trade press reported a pivot — no operating entity to count.

outside.name: One% Nutrition
outside.status: Operating — no traceable legal entity yet
outside.why: Protein-water brand, ~9 staff, Jakarta and Bali operations, two pre-seed rounds (Init-6 May 2025; Ondine Capital-led early 2026, six-digit USD, both undisclosed). LinkedIn self-declares HQ Singapore and no SG or ID registration is traceable under the brand — it enters the census when an entity surfaces.

outside.name: Bioma
outside.why: Product-as-a-service rentals (PT Bioma Bersama Indonesia; pre-seed co-led East Ventures and Init-6, Oct 2022). By Aug 2026: 7 people on LinkedIn, both domains unreachable, no press since 2022. Queued — one verified operating signal short of a row.

gdp-venture.name: GDP Venture
gdp-venture.hq: Wisma 77 Tower 2 Lt. 8, Jl. Letjen S. Parman Kav. 77, Slipi, Jakarta Barat
gdp-venture.about: The Djarum Group’s digital venture builder, founded in 2010 by Martin Hartono; On Lee is CTO, Danny Wirianto CBO, Benny Sudrata CFO, with Antonny Liem and Kusumo Martanto as founding partners. It builds and buys as much as it invests: Blibli, tiket.com, Kaskus and Garasi.id are group builds, Kumparan and IDN arrived as media investments, the Cermati group came in at its 2018 Series B, and a product arm (GDP Labs) incubates SaaS like CATAPA. Its published portfolio — 48 names on the page, read 30 Aug 2026 — also carries a substantial US entertainment book (88rising, Triller, Now United, Aptera) that sits outside an Indonesian census by definition. Kaskus and Prosa.ai carry GDP Venture on their census rows from earlier evidence despite being absent from the current page.

outside.name: Duniaku
outside.why: Gaming-media brand run inside IDN (PT Media Putra Nusantara); the census’s IDN row already counts its people and output — a separate row would double-count.

outside.why: Esports/gaming community brand inside IDN; contained in the census’s IDN row.

outside.name: GLAIR
outside.why: No dedicated entity: GDP Labs’ AI research team grown into a brand (KrAsia interview with its founder); its site footer sits at PT Darta Media Indonesia’s registered address and no PT GLAIR exists in the registry. A product line inside another PT does not get a row — the Jenius rule.

outside.name: MXA (MediaXAsia)
outside.why: Ad-buying unit inside PT Merah Cipta Media: its GM sits on MCM’s payroll, its LinkedIn HQ is MCM’s own Wisma 77 floor, no dedicated PT was found, and the fund page’s own link to it now 404s.

outside.name: Bolalob
outside.why: A sports-media brand, never its own PT — ran inside Kaskus (bolalob.com still serves PT Darta Media Indonesia’s *.kaskus.co.id certificate) and was integrated into the kumparan ecosystem on 29 May 2026; the brand lives on Instagram (~1.2M followers).

outside.name: Springboard
outside.why: Real and recently active (ran the 2025 Scooter Prix series at Sentul on TVRI, produced 88rising’s Head In The Clouds Jakarta; founder David Wayne Ika) but no PT name is traceable and springboard.id has no DNS today; queued until the entity or the site surfaces.

outside.name: 12WIRED
outside.why: Operating Jakarta music company (10 people on a live LinkedIn read, 30 Aug 2026; CEO Nadia Yustina, ex-Sony Music) in the Merah Cipta Media stable, addressed in GDP’s own Wisma 77 building — but no PT name is traceable today; queued until the entity surfaces.

outside.name: ProPS
outside.why: PT Promedia Punggawa Satu (reg. 728556, BSD City; 2017 KASKUS strategic investment, press names GDP Venture) — but props.id timed out from two independent networks on 30 Aug 2026 and nothing newer than its 8 May 2026 LinkedIn post is verifiable. Flips to a row when the site or fresher activity returns.
